caption: One 7-bit stream, three rules. NRZ-L copies each bit into the level; NRZ-I flips only at each 1, so the marked columns hold every flip; AMI signs each 1 in turn and sits at 0 V for every 0.

spec.title: Bits 1 0 1 1 0 0 1 in three line codes
spec.aria: A table of the bit stream 1 0 1 1 0 0 1 with the levels each line code gives: NRZ-L +1 −1 +1 +1 −1 −1 +1, NRZ-I −1 −1 +1 −1 −1 −1 +1, and AMI +1 0 −1 +1 0 0 −1.
